feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 10 May 2026 4:16pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 10 May 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure over the Irish Sea will continue to decline, allowing a weak weather front to move southwards across the area later tonight and at first tomorrow.


##Wind##

North or northwest 4 or 5, but variable 2 to 4 in the southwest of the area at first, increasing occasionally force 6 overnight. Veering north or northeast 4 or 5 tomorrow morning before backing north or northwest 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate for a time.


##Weather##

Fair to start, then occasional showery outbreaks of rain overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showery rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northwest 3 to 5, backing west or southwest 4 or 5 overnight into Tuesday, veering west or northwest 4 to 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair to start, then occasional rain, fair again later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain.
